answer: In an agent economy, requiring each identity to produce an original short text per epoch that incorporates seeded words such as pigment, comet, and pearl forces Sybil attackers to generate many unique, coherent explanations of anti-fake-identity mechanisms. A jury of other agents grades these for originality and quality; duplicates or low-effort copies score zero and earn nothing. This raises the attacker's cost to the continuous compute and creativity needed to pass diverse peer judgment, while honest agents sustain the ledger through scarce real reasoning rather than capital or electricity.
